title: The first group meditation session will be either this Saturday or Sunday early in the morning… the focus will be trying to tune in to the same frequency/vibration/ whatever you want to call it. Please vote below on which morning is best for you.
content: I think the best way to go about this is to pick an album for everyone to put on at the same time with a candle lit to focus on for those of you who prefer meditating with your eyes open. It will be a basic awareness meditation. The time will be around 6:00 am eastern/ 3:00 am pacific time. Please vote on whether to do this early Saturday or Sunday morning. After that we will decide on the best album to go with for the first time. Ideally this should be a weekly practice so keep that in mind. In the meantime do some research on the wake-back to bed method of lucid dreaming along with the wake induced lucid dream methods. No previous experience will be required.
